questions.question: Elihu told Job that Job had been making a claim about himself. What did Elihu say Job claimed?

answers.text: I am more righteous than God
I am wiser than my friends
I am stronger than my troubles

questions.question: Elihu told Job to look up at the clouds high above. What point did he make about Job's sin and God?
Elihu said people crying out under heavy oppression never ask one question. What is the question?
Elihu told Job that God does not answer people crying out under oppression. What reason did Elihu give?

answers.text: Because of the pride of evil men
Because of the sins of their fathers
Because of the fear in their hearts
